# William DeMeo

> Mathematician and formal verification engineer. Machine-checked mathematics:
> proofs and production systems in Agda, universal algebra and lattice theory,
> and AI tooling that lets language models work inside a proof assistant.
> PhD in mathematics (universal algebra); currently on the Formal Methods team
> at IO, working on the machine-checked Cardano ledger specification and on
> agda-native-air, an MCP server exposing Agda's interaction protocol to
> language models.

This site is being rebuilt; some sections (talks, teaching, research
narrative) are still migrating. Progress:
https://github.com/williamdemeo/williamdemeo.github.io/issues

## Projects

- [Projects index](https://williamdemeo.github.io/projects/): the portfolio,
  ordered by relevance — AI for formal verification first.
- [agda-algebras](https://williamdemeo.github.io/projects/agda-algebras/): the
  Agda Universal Algebra Library — first constructive, machine-checked proof of
  Birkhoff's HSP theorem in Martin-Löf type theory. Docs:
  https://agda-algebras.universalalgebra.org/ Source:
  https://github.com/ualib/agda-algebras
- [Cardano ledger specification](https://williamdemeo.github.io/projects/cardano-ledger/):
  formal methods at production scale — an Agda specification tracking a live
  system. Source: https://github.com/IntersectMBO/formal-ledger-specifications
- [agda-native-air](https://github.com/formalverification/agda-native-air): MCP
  server and agent loops that let language models drive Agda's interaction
  protocol — typechecker feedback as dense, verifiable reward signal. Project
  page forthcoming.
